mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart_item (member_id, product_id, quantity) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{productId}, #{quantity})
mapper.select: SELECT ci.id, ci.product_id, p.name AS product_name, p.price, ci.quantity, p.status AS product_status FROM cart_item ci JOIN product p ON p.id = ci.product_id WHERE ci.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY ci.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CAST(p.price AS SIGNED) * ci.quantity), 0) FROM cart_item ci JOIN product p ON p.id = ci.product_id WHERE ci.member_id = #{memberId} AND p.status = 'ON_SALE'
